Excusum in Officina VRANIBVRGICA', 4to, 30 leaves, colophon 'IMPRESSVM VRANIBVRGI IN INSVLA CELEBRIS PORTHMI DANICI HVAENA', no printing year on the title (Nielsen, Tycho Brahes Bogtrykkeri paa Hveen, 1921, pp. 186–187; three copies at KB Copenhagen, one with an autograph dedication from Tycho to the Schleswig pastor Albert Meier).
